notes.title: XEROES Update: Exciting Milestones & Upcoming Events!
notes.content:
Hello, amazing gamers!

It has been quite the journey since we embarked on this project, and we couldn’t have come this far without your incredible support. Once again, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you, especially to our private testers—your feedback has been invaluable in shaping XEROES into what it is today. Your continuous belief in our vision fuels our drive to make this game the best it can be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079668/4e5dc08486206ecd293c2e1c64c030de04242463.jpg[/img]

Now, we have some fantastic news to share: XEROES has been nominated for the [b]LEVEL UP KL: SEA Game Awards 2024[/b]! 🏆 We are beyond thrilled with this recognition, and it’s all thanks to your support and input. But that’s not all! We’ll also be attending the [b]Tokyo Game Show 2024[/b] to showcase our game to the global audience. It's a huge milestone for us, and we can’t wait to see what the future holds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079668/46d27a051813b9d4fb69035572804e23a93a5496.png[/img]

If you happen to be attending Tokyo Game Show, please stop by our booth to experience the XEROESdemo firsthand and meet the team behind the game. We would love to hear your thoughts in person!

And for those who can't make it, we've got more good news: XEROES is now live on Steam, and you can wishlist it today! 🚀 A public demo build will be available soon, so be sure to stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us—we couldn't do it without you!

Stay awesome,
The XEROES Team, Rcade Studio
